selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the service was active, listening on 0.0.0.0:8080, and returned the exact required response through 10.100.42.10.
The systemd service was enabled and restarted automatically after node reboot.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 1db3db2e-dca8-44d6-8402-3b99605ae056, received reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID 212d3db6-7967-40c7-8ae6-16b555ea32a4, and proved full service/content recovery.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; cat /etc/os-release | sed -n 's/^PRETTY_NAME=//p'
printf 'uid='; id -u
printf 'port8080='; ss -ltnp '( sport = :8080 )' || true
for s in nginx httpd caddy lighttpd; do printf '%s=' "$s"; systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || true; done
for p in nginx apache caddy lighttpd python; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf 'command_%s=%s\n' "$p" "$(command -v "$p")" || true; done
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.42.10
boot_id=1db3db2e-dca8-44d6-8402-3b99605ae056
os="Arch Linux"
uid=0
port8080=State Recv-Q Send-Q Local Address:Port Peer Address:PortProcess
nginx=inactive
httpd=inactive
caddy=inactive
lighttpd=inactive
command_python=/usr/bin/python

commands.command:
set -eu
getent passwd nobody
getent group nobody

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /srv/os-comparison
printf '%s\n' 'os-comparison-ready' > /srv/os-comparison/index.html
chown root:root /srv/os-comparison/index.html
chmod 0644 /srv/os-comparison/index.html
printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=Static OS comparison web service' 'After=network-online.target' 'Wants=network-online.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=simple' 'ExecStart=/usr/bin/python -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /srv/os-comparison' 'WorkingDirectory=/srv/os-comparison' 'Restart=on-failure' 'RestartSec=2' 'User=nobody' 'Group=nobody' 'NoNewPrivileges=true' 'PrivateTmp=true' 'ProtectSystem=strict' 'ProtectHome=true' 'ReadOnlyPaths=/srv/os-comparison' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > /etc/systemd/system/os-comparison-web.service
chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/os-comparison-web.service
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/os-comparison-web.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now os-comparison-web.service

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled os-comparison-web.service
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active os-comparison-web.service
systemctl show os-comparison-web.service -p MainPID -p SubState -p ExecMainStatus --no-pager
ss -ltnp '( sport = :8080 )'
body=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/")
printf 'url=http://%s:8080/\n' "$NODE_IP"
printf 'response=%s\n' "$body"
test "$body" = 'os-comparison-ready'
printf 'content_check=PASS\n'
commands.stdout:
